_about: Unreal-side settings for ue_follow.py / ue_attach.py / ue_material_swap.py. No paths to your PC are needed: the scripts find this folder themselves.
_archicad_port: null = use archicad_port from ../config.json, else env ARCHICAD_PORT, else scan 19723-19743 (one Archicad open).
_element_types: Datasmith actors with the tag Archicad.Element.Type.<type> are followed (Object = library-part furniture).
_rebuild: true = also call Tapir RebuildView after a send (only if your Archicad plan does not redraw by itself).
_mark_dirty: Actors moved by the follower are marked modified, so File > Save actually writes the level.

attach._about: ue_attach.py: real furniture meshes attached as children of the Datasmith actors. Meshes: upright, real size, pivot anywhere.
attach._mesh_front: Direction the meshes face in their own Unreal axes (+Y for most Poly Haven models). Per item: "mesh_front".
attach._items: match: kind (same names as ../config.json kinds), libpart (part-name substring) or guid. fit: none | uniform | box | height. Optional: yaw (extra deg), on_top, offset_cm [x,y,z] in the parent's axes, mesh_front.

material_swap._about: ue_material_swap.py: restyle the material ASSETS Datasmith created (asset level, no per-actor loop). Re-run after every Direct Link reimport.
material_swap._map: your material (instance) path -> Datasmith material asset names (exact or substring).
